```{r}
phylo_16s <- readRDS("16S/filtered_silva.rds")
filtered_16s <- prune_samples(sample_data(phylo_16s)$control == "sample", phylo_16s)
filtered_16s <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(filtered_16s) > 0, filtered_16s)
filtered_16s <- prune_samples(sample_data(filtered_16s)$pct %in% c("-PCT_1", "+PCT_1"), filtered_16s)


phylo_cpn60 <- readRDS("cpn60/filtered.rds")
filtered_cpn60 <- prune_samples(sample_data(phylo_cpn60)$control == "sample", phylo_cpn60)
filtered_cpn60 <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(filtered_cpn60) > 0, filtered_cpn60)
filtered_cpn60 <- prune_samples(sample_data(filtered_cpn60)$pct %in% c("-PCT_1", "+PCT_1"), filtered_cpn60)

```

```{r}
library(vegan)
library(dplyr)

generate_permanova_grid <- function(ps_obj,
                                    formula_vars, # character vector of variables in model
                                    ranks = c("species", "genus"),
                                    dists = c("euclidean", "bray", "jaccard", "jsd", "unifrac", "wunifrac")) {
  
  all_results <- list()
  
  for (rank in ranks) {
    for (dist in dists) {
      message("Processing PERMANOVA for Rank: ", rank, " | Distance: ", dist)
      
      # Transform appropriately for each distance
      if (dist %in% c("bray", "jaccard", "jsd")) {
        ps_rank <- ps_obj %>%
          tax_fix(unknowns = c("Clostridiales_bacterium")) %>%
          tax_transform("identity", rank = rank)
      } else if (dist == "euclidean") {
        ps_rank <- ps_obj %>%
          tax_fix(unknowns = c("Clostridiales_bacterium")) %>%
          tax_transform("identity", rank = rank)
      } else if (dist %in% c("unifrac", "wunifrac")) {
        ps_rank <- ps_obj %>%
          tax_fix(unknowns = c("Clostridiales_bacterium")) %>%
          tax_transform("identity", rank = "unique")
      }
      
      # Distance matrix
      dist_mat <- phyloseq::distance(ps_rank, method = dist)
      
      # Metadata
      meta <- as(sample_data(ps_rank), "data.frame")
      
      # Formula for PERMANOVA
      form <- as.formula(paste("dist_mat ~ ", paste(formula_vars, collapse = " + ")))
      
      # Run PERMANOVA (marginal effects)
      adonis_res <- adonis2(form, data = meta, by = "margin")
      
      # Store results in tidy format
      res_df <- as.data.frame(adonis_res) %>%
        tibble::rownames_to_column("Variable") %>%
        filter(Variable %in% formula_vars) %>% # keep only model vars
        mutate(Rank = rank,
               Distance = dist)
      
      all_results[[paste(rank, dist, sep = "_")]] <- res_df
    }
  }
  
  permanova_df <- bind_rows(all_results)
  return(permanova_df)
}


```

## All variables

```{r}
use <- c("pct", "age", "bmi_english", "menarche", "postmeno_yrs", "contraceptives", "hrt")
permanova_results_16S_all <- generate_permanova_grid(filtered_16s, use)
permanova_results_16S_all_copy <- permanova_results_16S_all


permanova_results_cpn60_all <- generate_permanova_grid(filtered_cpn60, use)
permanova_results_cpn60_all_copy <- permanova_results_cpn60_all
```

library(scales)

permanova_results_16S_all_copy$Variable <- factor(permanova_results_16S_all_copy$Variable,

                                              labels = c("PCT", "Age",  "BMI",

```{r, fig.height=10, fig.width=20}

a <- permanova_results_16S_all_copy %>% 
filter(Rank ==  "species") %>%
ggplot( aes(x = Distance, y = forcats::fct_rev(Variable), fill = R2)) +
  geom_tile(color = "grey80") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(signif(R2, 2))), color = "black", size = 5.5) +
  # Add black border for significant p-values
  geom_tile(data = subset(permanova_results_16S_all_copy %>% filter(Rank %in% c("species")), `Pr(>F)` < 0.05),
            aes(x = Distance, y = forcats::fct_rev(Variable)),
            color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", midpoint = 0, limits = c(0, 0.08)) +
  facet_grid(Rank ~ type) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 19) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 19, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 19),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 19, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 19, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 19, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 17),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 19, face = "bold")  # bigger facet titles
  )  + ylab("") + xlab("") 
#dev.off()

```
